scope: Iris Gazebo SITL; original position P, XYZ velocity PID, attitude and rate PID
randomness: Unmodified default-constructed sensor engines, not independent random seeds
logging: Preserve startup SDLOG_PROFILE bits, OR 16; restart logger -b 256 -r 1000 -t -f before warmup
target_source: Original flight_mode_manager is sole trajectory publisher. Default-off SITL module test adds X/NED velocity after original position P using ControlMath constrainXY; no MAVLink/offboard/attitude/rate setpoint publisher. Z/yaw untouched.
sequence: Fresh start; warmup>=30s; original takeoff and Hold; 60s observation. First airborne AUTO_LOITER opens single-shot timer: 12s settle, 32s smooth zero-integral X velocity waveform, rest; land/disarm. Gate break inhibits until disarm, not restart.
metric: Primary: actual consumed v-v_sp time-weighted per-axis RMSE/IAE within complete excitation_time in [0,32). Separate 60s hover diagnostics and historical V00 async baseline metrics. No fabricated interpolation. TV on consecutive actual updates.
failure_action: Stop owned SITL via original runner; preserve all logs and failure; no fallback controller, zero-thrust safety claim, retry or remaining attempt
parameter_restore: Archive original complete EEPROM bytes before experiment, restore exact bytes after each stopped run; save runtime full parameters before/after
authorization: V03 user request + continue authorized prerequisite repair, offline protection/logging, exactly one PID small velocity flight. No retries.
world_verification: Exactly one live gzserver, same session as launch session leader; exact absolute .world argv, PX4_SITL_WORLD and master URI; frozen file SHA-256. Model path checked separately from launcher console.

excitation.axes_unmodified: Y/Z; original position P remains active

diagnostic_gate.strict_failures: Any required check fails: stop and preserve, no additional flight.

v04_prefreeze.source: V00/V01 PID noise scale (X .010751,Y .008080,Z .005138m/s); V03 provides consumed-state baseline. Fixed before any ESTA data.
v04_prefreeze.per_pair_rule: candidate_rmse <= 1.25*paired_PID_rmse + frozen absolute allowance; each commanded/noncommanded axis separately
v04_prefreeze.order: future V04: PID/ESTA paired x3; needs user authorization and gains/seed freeze
